payload.claim: The claim never states what happens when the find sits at the end of the file, so there is no following kept line at all, even though one of the seven named witness cases is exactly the SA-0390 edit refused "at the end of a file." A builder has to infer that "followed by a first non-blank kept line of before" is vacuously satisfied when no such line exists. Because this exact scenario is one of the seven witness-driven cases, a build that mishandles it fails the witness directly, so the gap is self-correcting rather than a live risk, but the prose itself is terse on this point.
